name: YE DIGITAL Corporation
summary: YE DIGITAL Corporation provides Internet of Things solutions in Japan. Its cloud products include MMCloud, an IoT platform for data storage, visualization and analysis, and MMPredict, which uses AI to predict faults, plus wireless camera monitoring, image inspection and factory security offerings. It took its current name in March 2019, dates from 1978 and has its head office in Kitakyushu, Japan.
